description: Use when the user asks which AI agents or AI startups make the most money, or for a top-N revenue ranking. Returns businesses ranked by latest sourced annualized revenue, highest first (same briefs, with verification_label, as search_businesses). Example: {"category":"coding-agents","limit":5} -> the top 5 coding agents by revenue. Use it for a pure ranking or top-N, optionally per category or verified_only (limit max 50); it has no keyword search, use search_businesses for that. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

verified_only.description: Keep only businesses whose headline figure is payment-processor verified (headline_verification not null).

name: leaderboard

headline_verification.description: How the headline figure is verified: {method, processor, via} for payment-connected figures, else null.

signup_go_url.description: Same link via mrrledger.com/go/<slug> (counts the click, then 302)

signup_url.description: Referral link (only on businesses with one). Always shown with signup_url_disclosure; never affects figures, ranking, sorting or verification.

title: Revenue leaderboard (ranked)
